matrix-rust-sdk Android bindings — public API surface
=====================================================
Source: org.matrix.rustcomponents:sdk-android:26.06.18 (classes.jar)
Generated with: javap -public   (Kotlin metadata stripped; suspend funs appear as
`java.lang.Object fn(..., kotlin.coroutines.Continuation<? super T>)` — the real
Kotlin signature is `suspend fun fn(...): T`. A trailing `throws XException`
means the Rust call can fail with that exception.)

Notes for porters:
- Every UniFFI object (Client, Room, Timeline, ...) implements Disposable/AutoCloseable;
  call destroy()/close() or use `.use { }` when done.
- Sealed classes appear as an abstract base plus `Base$Variant` nested classes;
  Kotlin code matches them with `when (x) { is TimelineItemContent.MsgLike -> ... }`.
- `-XXXX` suffixes on method names (e.g. getMaxMediaUploadSize-I7RO_PI) are Kotlin
  unsigned-type name mangling; from Kotlin you just call getMaxMediaUploadSize()
  and get a ULong.
- Top-level package functions (init(), messageEventContentFromMarkdown(), sdkGitSha(),
  mediaSourceFromUrl(), ...) live in Matrix_sdk_ffiKt — from Kotlin they are plain
  top-level functions in org.matrix.rustcomponents.sdk.
- $Companion / FfiConverter* / Uniffi* plumbing classes are omitted (boilerplate).
